items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: but I know that he played with the band with it.

ctx.x: Yeah. It did have some keys though.

Yeah, but how many I really couldn't tell you, but I know that he played with the band with it. And I know the band didn't play in one key. So it must have been right, it must have been equalized to a C. Yeah. That's a way too. Yeah, it's quite heavy. Maybe that metal head on the biggolone. Yeah. It's really strong. Yeah, it's probably pretty old, probably 40 or 50 or more than 40 I'd say.

Speaking about the way they make things, take a look at the joint on that, Meyer. It comes, I think there's either one or two joints there. Just pull it apart and you'll see. Oh, it just slips apart. Yeah. Oh.
